issues: Meaning drift: "Mengingat" should be translated as "Considering"/"Whereas" in the sense of "Having regard to", not "In View of" (nonstandard legal rendering that can affect downstream indicator parsing).
Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 2: items e–g are run together ("e...; f...; andg...") and item (2) is not marked as a separate paragraph/numbered item.
Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 3: letter item d is merged into item c ("...legislation; andd...").
Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 4: letter item d is merged into item c ("...prevention; andd...").

Scrambled/altered list structure in Article 2: original has 'Azas (1) ... meliputi:' followed by lettered items a–g, then a separate item '2. Kepastian Hukum dan Kearifan lokal.'; translation renders 'Principles' as a standalone line and changes '2.' into a continuation of the same list without matching the original structure.

Minor meaning drift in Article 2 item 2: 'Kepastian Hukum dan Kearifan lokal' should be rendered as a principle alongside the others; keep it as numbered item '2.' as in the original (not merged into (1) list).
Scrambled/merged list markers: several items are concatenated (e.g., 'andf.', 'andc.', 'ande.') causing list structure to be broken in Articles 5, 7, 8, 9, 13, 16, 17, 18.

Meaning drift/omission risk due to merged markers: some conjunctions and item boundaries are unclear (e.g., Article 5 e–f; Article 7 b–c; Article 8 (1) a–f; Article 9 d–e; Article 13 (1) a–b, (2) b–c, (3) b–c; Article 16 d–e; Article 17 d–e; Article 18 b–c).
Scrambled/incorrect list marker formatting in Article 10: item b is not marked as "b." (it appears as a continuation after item a).

Meaning drift/grammar error in Article 18 letter c: "to carry out prevention and against women and children" is missing the object of prevention; should be "prevention of acts of violence against women and children" (pencegahan ... dari tindak kekerasan).

Scrambled/merged list structure: several lettered items are attached to preceding text without a line break (e.g., 'fields of:a.', 'covering:a.', 'include:a.'), and some markers are merged ('andg.', 'andf.', 'andd.'), which can break downstream boundary splitting.
Minor meaning/terminology drift: 'ketenteraman dan ketertiban' is better rendered as 'tranquility and public order' (not 'peace and order'); keep legal sense.
Punctuation/structure: missing period at end of Article 21(2) sentence; list items should be clearly separated and consistently formatted.

Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 32(2): the marker "a." is merged into the preceding sentence ("...form of:a.") and items a–b run together; line breaks/markers are not cleanly separated as in the original, risking downstream boundary parsing.

Scrambled list structure in Article 32(2): in the original, items a–e are run together ("...berupa:a. ... kelurahanb. ... dane."), but the translation presents them as separate items; needs correction to ensure each marker a–e corresponds to the correct content and includes the missing punctuation/word breaks ("and" before e).
Minor meaning/terminology drift: "sosialisasi" is better rendered as "dissemination/outreach" rather than "socialization" in a legal/policy context; adjust to avoid awkward/misleading term.

Scrambled/flattened internal structure: markers such as Huruf/Letter a–g, Ayat/Paragraph 1–4, Butir/Point a–b are run together in single paragraphs instead of being clearly separated in the same order as the original, risking boundary-based retrieval errors.
Minor meaning/term drift: 'aparat desa/kelurahan' is rendered as 'village/sub-district officials' (kelurahan is urban village, not sub-district); keep as 'village/urban village officials'.
